contracts.commit_point: workflows.py:128 — await Runner.run(self.plant_matrix_agent, user_input), where the registered input guardrail evaluates user_input; a trip aborts the agent run before the second Runner.run stage (workflows.py:129-132) and before run_pipeline's post-run log writes (ecooptima.py:62-66), with the raised InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered handled at ecooptima.py:118-120.
contracts.declared_mechanism: InputGuardrail(guardrail_function=self.eco_optima_guardrail) declared in input_guardrails on the plant_matrix_agent Agent (workflows.py:117-119); eco_optima_guardrail delegates the input to the 'Guardrail' agent via Runner.run(self.guardrail_agent, input_data) and sets tripwire_triggered=not final_output.is_eco_optima on the GuardrailOutput verdict (workflows.py:58-65); a trip raises InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered, which ecooptima.main catches to block the pipeline and return the block message (ecooptima.py:118-120).
contracts.forbidden_condition: plant_matrix_agent processing user input that the guardrail classifies as off-topic: GuardrailOutput.is_eco_optima evaluates false (the 'Guardrail' agent judges the user is not asking about plants), so eco_optima_guardrail returns tripwire_triggered=True and the guarded Runner.run raises InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered instead of completing the agent run.

contracts.protected_operation: Runner.run(self.plant_matrix_agent, user_input) in CommunityWorkflow.run (workflows.py:128) — the Plant Matrix Advisor agent run consuming raw user input, whose successful completion feeds the downstream local_roi_agent stage (workflows.py:129-132).
contracts.protected_resource: The CommunityWorkflow plant-matrix analysis pipeline: the plant_matrix_agent ('Plant Matrix Advisor') run and its downstream processing (local_roi_agent stage and its FileSearchTool / plot_bar_chart tool effects), reached from ecooptima.main via run_pipeline.
contracts.protection_obligation: Off-topic (non-plant) user input is forbidden from being processed by the CommunityWorkflow 'Plant Matrix Advisor' agent: the InputGuardrail (eco_optima_guardrail) registered on plant_matrix_agent at agent construction must evaluate the raw user input and trip InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered when the guardrail agent's is_eco_optima verdict is false, aborting the agent run at the Runner.run(self.plant_matrix_agent, user_input) commit point in CommunityWorkflow.run and thereby halting the pipeline (including the downstream local_roi_agent stage with vector-store search and chart-writing tools), with the tripwire caught and surfaced in ecooptima.main. (Merged from duplicate first- and second-phase reviewer wording.)
scope_limits: Community workflow only: ConsumerWorkflow, AcademicWorkflow, BusinessWorkflow, and GovernmentWorkflow register no input guardrails on any of their agents (workflows.py:206-257, 350-439, 517-573, 653-771).
The conversational follow-up path (run_followup -> Runner.run(workflow.conversational_agent, ...), ecooptima.py:73-81) is not covered by this guardrail.

The topicality verdict is produced by the LLM 'Guardrail' agent (gpt-5-nano) prompted to 'Check if the user is asking about plants' (workflows.py:98-105); no deterministic policy rule is supplied in source.
The guard fires only at the plant_matrix_agent run; it does not screen the local_roi_agent input (agent-generated JSON) or any other stage.
Side effects occurring before workflow.run in run_pipeline (log directory creation and ECOOPTIMA_LOG_DIR env assignment, ecooptima.py:56-58) are not undone by the trip.
